name: clientbooks-hub
description: For accountants and bookkeepers who manage many client orgs; works with Xero. Connect each client read-only, then ask across all of them: overdue invoices 30/60/90+, who is closest to missing payroll, client health scores, practice revenue and DSO, and a ready-to-send Excel month-end pack per client. Tokens are encrypted at rest; financial data is never stored.
